entries.title: Record feedback on purchase orders
entries.description: Submit feedback from a purchase order or a linked job, and search job activity by PO number or supplier. Submitted feedback cannot be edited or deleted.

entries.title: Browse stock on hand in batches
entries.description: Load more stock rows as needed. Search and sorting cover the full list, including parts you have not loaded yet.

entries.title: Find stock actions on smaller screens
entries.description: Stock on hand now groups its action buttons into an Actions menu when space is limited.

entries.title: Retry loading parts for label printing
entries.description: The inventory label picker now shows when parts are loading and offers Retry if loading fails.

entries.title: Send purchase order feedback from a job
entries.description: Choose Send PO Feedback in a job’s Activity tab to leave feedback on a linked purchase order. Feedback appears in linked jobs’ activity and cannot be edited or deleted.
